FULL TEXT:
High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 06/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG- 08/2026
It is hereby notified for the information of all the Stake Holders
that, the Cause List would be prepared 24 hours prior. Accordingly, the
Cause List for 07/10/2026 would be generated on 06/10/2026, the
Cause List for 08/10/2026 would be generated on 07/10/2026, and so
on, till the Cause List for 19/10/2026. The Cause List for 21/10/2026
would be generated on 17/10/2026 . Thereafter, from 19.10.2026 the
existing practice of generating the Cause list 48 hours in advance shall
be restored.
By Order
Sd/-
Date: 06/10/2026 Registrar (Judicial)
